details.description: Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime, released by Mistral AI on February 4, 2026 as an open-weight sibling to Voxtral Mini Transcribe V2, is a 4-billion-parameter streaming speech-to-text model published on Hugging Face as Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602 under the Apache 2.0 license. Mistral describes it as purpose-built for live transcription, pairing a roughly 3.4B-parameter language model with a roughly 970M-parameter causal audio encoder to support configurable transcription delay from 80ms up to 2.4 seconds. Mistral's own Hugging Face model card reports an average FLEURS word error rate of 8.72% at a 480ms delay, versus 5.90% for the offline Voxtral Mini Transcribe V2, with per-language WER at that delay ranging from 3.31% for Spanish to 22.53% for Arabic.
advantages: Mistral's launch post states latency is configurable down to sub-200ms, enabling voice agents and other real-time applications.
Open-weight under the Apache 2.0 license and published on Hugging Face as Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602, per Mistral's model card.
Uses a natively streaming architecture with causal attention in the audio encoder and sliding-window attention for continuous streaming, per Mistral's Hugging Face model card.
Mistral's model card states that at a 480ms delay it matches the performance of leading offline open-source transcription models, with throughput exceeding 12.5 tokens per second.
disadvantages: Mistral's own Hugging Face model card reports a higher average FLEURS word error rate at a 480ms delay (8.72%) than its offline sibling Voxtral Mini Transcribe V2 (5.90%), a roughly 2.8-point accuracy trade-off for lower latency.
Per-language accuracy varies widely on Mistral's FLEURS benchmark at 480ms delay, from 3.31% WER for Spanish to 22.53% WER for Arabic, per Mistral's Hugging Face model card.
Mistral's launch post lists context biasing and word-level timestamps as features of Voxtral Mini Transcribe V2 only, not of this realtime model.
use_cases: Real-time voice agents and virtual assistants, per Mistral's Voxtral Transcribe 2 launch post.
Live subtitle generation, per Mistral's Hugging Face model card.
Private, on-device meeting transcription, per Mistral's Hugging Face model card.
Contact center automation, per Mistral's Voxtral Transcribe 2 launch post.

sources.title: Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime | Mistral AI

notes: This is the 'latest' alias for the same model as voxtral-mini-transcribe-realtime-2602 (Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime / Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602); Mistral's docs model page lists both id strings together for this one model. Mistral's launch post separately states this model 'stays within 1-2% word error rate' at a 480ms delay, which does not match the more detailed benchmark table on Mistral's own Hugging Face model card (8.72% average FLEURS WER at the same 480ms delay, ranging 3.31%-22.53% by language); flagged rather than resolved since both are maker sources. Catalog facts give no max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens or deprecation_date for this model, so there is nothing to reconcile there.
